# Syzygy test fixtures

These eight generated three-piece tables total 26,240 bytes. They are test
inputs only and are not embedded in the competition binary.

Source: [python-chess fixture directory](https://github.com/niklasf/python-chess/tree/0c6bdaccfcb3b09cdbe94b0f81e948cb2a356015/data/syzygy/regular),
revision `0c6bdaccfcb3b09cdbe94b0f81e948cb2a356015`, downloaded 2026-09-12.
Tablebases were created by Ronald de Man. His [generator terms](https://github.com/syzygy1/tb#terms-of-use)
permit redistribution of generated tablebase files. No python-chess source
code is included.

WDL-only and incomplete-directory tests copy subsets to temporary directories;
the default tests require neither network access nor a user tablebase install.
